title: Finite comparison identifies the specified bounded finite-Tor generators
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $B$ be a finite discrete commutative ring. Fix a monoidal ring isomorphism from the sheafified constant ring with value $B$ on profinite sets to the continuous-function condensed ring of $B$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant]. Its pullback identifies the constant scheme ring with the pulled-back condensed ring [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-ring-constant]. Let $R_X$ be the specified coefficient realization: view fixed-scalar module sheaves as internal module presheaves, apply monoidal sheafification, and restrict scalars along the inverse of this pulled-back isomorphism. For ordinary module-valued sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], comparison inverse image sends every etale bounded constructible finite-Tor complex [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] to a pro-etale complex whose image under $D(R_X)$ has bounded constant-model constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible, det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. Conversely every pro-etale complex satisfying this transported predicate is isomorphic, in the ambient derived category, to the specified comparison image of an etale bounded constructible finite-Tor complex. No base field or primary-coefficient hypothesis is needed for this bounded statement.

proof.text: Use the two replete-image equalities in the coefficient-presentation lemma for the explicitly constructed realizations E and G.

The lifted finite ring A is Noetherian. Apply finiteTorComparisonNoetherian to obtain D, its localization factorization, the finite-Tor equivalence H and the ambient comparison hH. The proved derived square identifies D with the ordinary comparison through E and G.

For an etale generator choose a model representative L and apply H. Compose G(hH_L), the inverse square at L and the image of its representative isomorphism. For the converse choose a model representative M, apply H.inverse, and compose the square, inverse ambient comparison and H counit to obtain an isomorphism to the given ordinary pro-etale object.

theorem finiteComparisonGenerators_identification (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    (∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1} B) X,
      finiteComparisonEtaleGenerators B X K →
        finiteComparisonProEtaleGenerators B eR X
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B))
            X).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ∧
    (∀ K : _root_.DerivedCategory
        (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B))),
      finiteComparisonProEtaleGenerators B eR X K →
        (finiteComparisonEtaleGenerators B X).map
          (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B))
            X).mapDerivedCategory K)
